title: Verification of NAD(P)H Concentration by NanoDrop
author: Daniel Moreira
materials: Open the NanoDrop software and select UV-Vis or the custom absorbance measurement mode.

steps.title: Configure NanoDrop Settings
steps.instruction: Set the measurement wavelength to 340 nm and the extinction coefficient to 6.22 mM⁻¹·cm⁻¹ if prompted by the software.

steps.title: Clean Pedestals
steps.instruction: Clean the upper and lower pedestals using a dry lint-free wipe.

steps.title: Perform Blank Measurement
steps.instruction: Pipette 1–2 µL of blank solvent onto the lower pedestal and close the arm.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Dilution
steps.instruction: If the stock concentration is ≥ 1 mM, prepare a diluted working sample (e.g., 1:20–1:100 in blank solvent) before measuring.

steps.title: Measure Sample Absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the sample absorbance at 340 nm in triplicate.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1–2 µL of sample (or diluted sample) onto the lower pedestal and close the arm.
Repeat the measurement for a total of 3 independent readings.

steps.title: Calculate Stock Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the stock concentration using the formula: c_stock (mM) = (A340 / 6.22) × dilution factor.

substeps.instruction: Use a dilution factor of 1 if the sample was measured undiluted.
Register the mean ± SD of the three measurements.

steps.title: Record Results
steps.instruction: Record the A340, the calculated concentration, and the following details in the lab notebook:

substeps.instruction: Nucleotide identity (NADH or NADPH) and preparation date
Three A340 readings and calculated stock concentrations
